item.title: Sample Page
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
This is an example page. It's different from a blog post because it will stay in one place and will show up in your site navigation (in most themes). Most people start with an About page that introduces them to potential site visitors. It might say something like this:

Hi there! I'm a bike messenger by day, aspiring actor by night, and this is my website. I live in Los Angeles, have a great dog named Jack, and I like piña coladas. (And gettin' caught in the rain.)

...or something like this:

The XYZ Doohickey Company was founded in 1971, and has been providing quality doohickeys to the public ever since. Located in Gotham City, XYZ employs over 2,000 people and does all kinds of awesome things for the Gotham community.

As a new WordPress user, you should go to your dashboard to delete this page and create new pages for your content. Have fun!

item.title: Refund and Returns Policy
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
This is a sample page.

Overview

Our refund and returns policy lasts 30 days. If 30 days have passed since your purchase, we can’t offer you a full refund or exchange.

To be eligible for a return, your item must be unused and in the same condition that you received it. It must also be in the original packaging.

Several types of goods are exempt from being returned. Perishable goods such as food, flowers, newspapers or magazines cannot be returned. We also do not accept products that are intimate or sanitary goods, hazardous materials, or flammable liquids or gases.

Additional non-returnable items:

  • Gift cards
  • Downloadable software products
  • Some health and personal care items

To complete your return, we require a receipt or proof of purchase.

Please do not send your purchase back to the manufacturer.

There are certain situations where only partial refunds are granted:

  • Book with obvious signs of use
  • CD, DVD, VHS tape, software, video game, cassette tape, or vinyl record that has been opened.
  • Any item not in its original condition, is damaged or missing parts for reasons not due to our error.
  • Any item that is returned more than 30 days after delivery

Refunds

Once your return is received and inspected, we will send you an email to notify you that we have received your returned item. We will also notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund.

If you are approved, then your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your credit card or original method of payment, within a certain amount of days.

Late or missing refunds

If you haven’t received a refund yet, first check your bank account again.

Then contact your credit card company, it may take some time before your refund is officially posted.

Next contact your bank. There is often some processing time before a refund is posted.

If you’ve done all of this and you still have not received your refund yet, please contact us at {email address}.

Sale items

Only regular priced items may be refunded. Sale items cannot be refunded.

Exchanges

We only replace items if they are defective or damaged. If you need to exchange it for the same item, send us an email at {email address} and send your item to: {physical address}.

Gifts

If the item was marked as a gift when purchased and shipped directly to you, you’ll receive a gift credit for the value of your return. Once the returned item is received, a gift certificate will be mailed to you.

If the item wasn’t marked as a gift when purchased, or the gift giver had the order shipped to themselves to give to you later, we will send a refund to the gift giver and they will find out about your return.

Shipping returns

To return your product, you should mail your product to: {physical address}.

You will be responsible for paying for your own shipping costs for returning your item. Shipping costs are non-refundable. If you receive a refund, the cost of return shipping will be deducted from your refund.

Depending on where you live, the time it may take for your exchanged product to reach you may vary.

If you are returning more expensive items, you may consider using a trackable shipping service or purchasing shipping insurance. We don’t guarantee that we will receive your returned item.

Need help?

Contact us at {email} for questions related to refunds and returns.

item.title: Home-2-sticky-section
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Our Mission

At THE TANKLESS, we believe hot water should be effortless, efficient, and worry-free. We exist to redefine how homeowners experience on-demand hot water—no scaling, no downtime, no guesswork. Our goal is simple: deliver endless hot water with zero maintenance, wrapped in smart, dependable technology. mi
Km Range
lbs
Frame Weight
kw
Per charge
ExploreMore

Our Story

THE TANKLESS was born out of a passion to solve one of the most frustrating problems homeowners face: maintenance hassles and performance loss in traditional tank-based water heaters—especially in areas with hard water. As part of the LG Home Comfort family, we combined decades of HVAC and water-heating experience with fresh innovation to build a next-generation solution engineered for real conditions. We saw that switching to tankless systems often introduced new pain points (frequent descaling, component wear, uncertainty about performance in hard water). So we set out to do something better: a tankless heater that doesn’t just “work,” but works reliably, over the long-term, with minimal effort from the user. 360-Degree Vision Motion Tracking Real-Time Interaction Play VideoKnow More

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Effective Date: October 31, 2025
Last Updated: October 31, 2025

At the Tankless, your privacy and trust are our top priorities. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you visit our website or interact with our services.

By using our website (http://localhost/thetankless) or submitting information through our forms, you agree to the terms of this policy.

1. Who We Are

the Tankless brings smart, space-saving, and cost-efficient hot water solutions to Canadian households. Built with engineering precision and designed for year-round Canadian weather, our advanced tankless technology delivers endless hot water while reducing energy use and freeing up valuable space.

Website: http://localhost/thetankless
Contact: info@the-tankless.ca

2. Information We Collect

We collect only the information necessary to serve you better and maintain site security. This may include:
  • Personal Information: Name, phone number, email, address (when submitting forms or booking consultations).
  • Technical Data: IP address, browser type, device information, and pages visited.
  • Cookies: Used to enhance your browsing experience and remember your preferences.
If you leave a comment or fill out a form, we may collect the data shown in that form, along with your IP address and browser details for spam detection and site protection.

3. How We Use Your Information

Your information helps us deliver a better experience. We use it to:
  • Respond to your service inquiries or quote requests.
  • Schedule and confirm appointments.
  • Improve our website and customer experience.
  • Send updates or special offers (only if you’ve opted in).
  • Detect and prevent spam or fraudulent activity.
We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal data to third parties.

4. Media Uploads

If you upload images (e.g., for consultation forms or installations), please avoid including location data (EXIF GPS). Visitors to our website may be able to download and extract that data from public images.

5. Cookies & Tracking

Cookies help us improve your browsing experience. They allow the site to remember your details and preferences.
  • Comment Cookies: Save your name, email, and website for future convenience.
  • Login Cookies: Maintain login sessions securely for users with accounts.
  • Analytics Cookies: Track anonymous visitor behaviour for performance insights.
You can disable cookies anytime through your browser settings, but some site features may not function properly.

6. Embedded Content

Some pages may include embedded content (like videos, forms, or maps) from trusted third-party sources. These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, or track your interaction. We recommend reviewing their respective privacy policies.

7. Data Sharing

We may share data only with trusted service providers who help us operate our business (e.g., hosting, analytics, spam detection). These partners are obligated to keep your data secure and confidential.

If you request a password reset, your IP address may be included in the reset email for security purposes.

8. Data Retention

Product warranties and service guarantees are subject to specific terms outlined at the time of purchase or installation. While we ensure high-quality workmanship and reliable products, the Tankless is not responsible for issues arising from user negligence, unauthorized modifications, or third-party repairs.
  • Comments and form submissions are retained indefinitely for record-keeping and customer support purposes.
  • Registered user information (if applicable) can be viewed, edited, or deleted by the user at any time, except usernames.
  • We retain essential data as required by Canadian administrative or legal obligations.

9. Your Rights

As a Canadian user, you have the right to:
  • Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
  • Request correction or deletion of your personal information.
  • Withdraw consent for marketing emails at any time.
To exercise these rights, contact us at support@thetankless.ca. We’ll respond promptly in accordance with Canadian privacy laws.

10. Data Security

We take your privacy seriously. Our website uses SSL encryption, secure servers, and spam-protection tools to safeguard your data. Access to your information is restricted to authorized personnel only.

11. Where Your Data Is Sent

Visitor comments or form submissions may be scanned through automated spam detection and security services to ensure safety and system reliability.

12. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date. We encourage you to review it periodically to stay informed.

13. Contact Us

If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy, please reach out to:
  • support@thetankless.ca
  • http://localhost/thetankless

Last Updated: October 31, 2025 

At The Tankless, your privacy and trust are our top priorities. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you visit our website or interact with our services. 

By using our website (http://localhost/thetankless) or submitting information through our forms, you agree to the terms of this policy. 

 

  1. Who We Are

The Tankless is a Canadian-owned and operated company specializing in tankless water heater systems across Ontario. Our goal is to provide customers with effortless, efficient, and reliable hot water solutions. 

Website: http://localhost/thetankless 
Contact: info@the-tankless.ca 

 

  1. Information We Collect

We collect only the information necessary to serve you better and maintain site security. This may include: 

  • Personal Information: Name, phone number, email, address (when submitting forms or booking consultations). 
  • Technical Data: IP address, browser type, device information, and pages visited. 
  • Cookies: Used to enhance your browsing experience and remember your preferences. 

If you leave a comment or fill out a form, we may collect the data shown in that form, along with your IP address and browser details for spam detection and site protection. 

 

  1. How We Use Your Information

Your information helps us deliver a better experience. We use it to: 

  • Respond to your service inquiries or quote requests. 
  • Schedule and confirm appointments. 
  • Improve our website and customer experience. 
  • Send updates or special offers (only if you’ve opted in). 
  • Detect and prevent spam or fraudulent activity. 

We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal data to third parties. 

 

  1. Media Uploads

If you upload images (e.g., for consultation forms or installations), please avoid including location data (EXIF GPS). Visitors to our website may be able to download and extract that data from public images. 

 

  1. Cookies & Tracking

Cookies help us improve your browsing experience. They allow the site to remember your details and preferences. 

  • Comment Cookies: Save your name, email, and website for future convenience. 
  • Login Cookies: Maintain login sessions securely for users with accounts. 
  • Analytics Cookies: Track anonymous visitor behaviour for performance insights. 

You can disable cookies anytime through your browser settings, but some site features may not function properly. 

 

  1. Embedded Content

Some pages may include embedded content (like videos, forms, or maps) from trusted third-party sources. These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, or track your interaction. We recommend reviewing their respective privacy policies. 

 

  1. Data Sharing

We may share data only with trusted service providers who help us operate our business (e.g., hosting, analytics, spam detection). These partners are obligated to keep your data secure and confidential. 

If you request a password reset, your IP address may be included in the reset email for security purposes. 

 

  1. Data Retention

  • Comments and form submissions are retained indefinitely for record-keeping and customer support purposes. 
  • Registered user information (if applicable) can be viewed, edited, or deleted by the user at any time, except usernames. 
  • We retain essential data as required by Canadian administrative or legal obligations. 

 

  1. Your Rights

As a Canadian user, you have the right to: 

  • Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you. 
  • Request correction or deletion of your personal information. 
  • Withdraw consent for marketing emails at any time. 

To exercise these rights, contact us at privacy@the-tankless.ca. We’ll respond promptly in accordance with Canadian privacy laws. 

 

  1. Data Security

We take your privacy seriously. Our website uses SSL encryption, secure servers, and spam-protection tools to safeguard your data. Access to your information is restricted to authorized personnel only. 

 

  1. Where Your Data Is Sent

Visitor comments or form submissions may be scanned through automated spam detection and security services to ensure safety and system reliability. 

 

  1. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date. We encourage you to review it periodically to stay informed. 

 

  1. Contact Us

If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy, please reach out to: 

The Tankless 
Email: privacy@thetankless.ca 
Website: http://localhost/thetankless

Effective Date: October 31, 2025
Last Updated: October 31, 2025

Welcome to the Tankless. These Terms and Conditions govern your use of our website, services, and products. By visiting our site or engaging with our services, you agree to comply with and be bound by the terms outlined below. Please read them carefully before using our website.

1. Site Usage

the Tankless website (http://localhost/thetankless) is designed to provide information about our products, services, promotions, and customer support. By accessing this site, you agree to use it responsibly and for lawful purposes only. You must not:
  • Copy, reproduce, or distribute any website content without permission.
  • Attempt to disrupt or damage the site, its servers, or its security features.
  • Misuse any form, chat, or contact functionality to send spam or false information.
We reserve the right to restrict or terminate access to our website for any misuse or violation of these terms.

2. Services and Offers

All product and service details listed on this site are provided for informational purposes and may be updated or changed without notice. While we make every effort to ensure accuracy, prices, promotions, and offers may vary based on availability, location, or seasonal campaigns. Quotes provided through online forms or consultations are estimates and subject to confirmation after an in-home assessment.

3. Limitation of Liability

the Tankless strives to ensure that all information provided on this website is accurate and up to date. However, we make no guarantees regarding:
  • The uninterrupted or error-free operation of the site.
  • The accuracy, completeness, or reliability of information presented.
the Tankless, its affiliates, and employees shall not be held liable for any direct or indirect damages arising from the use or inability to use this website, including service delays, technical issues, or third-party links.

4. User Responsibilities

By using our website, you agree to provide accurate and honest information in any forms, comments, or requests you submit. You are solely responsible for ensuring that your actions on this site comply with applicable Canadian laws and regulations. Unauthorized access, misuse of data, or attempts to interfere with the website’s operation may lead to legal action.

5. Intellectual Property

All content on this website—including text, graphics, logos, videos, and images—is the intellectual property of the Tankless unless otherwise stated. You may not reproduce, distribute, or modify any part of this website without prior written consent. Unauthorized use of our intellectual property may violate copyright, trademark, or other applicable laws.

6. Privacy and Data Protection

Your privacy is important to us. Any personal data collected through this website (such as contact forms, quote requests, or analytics) is handled according to our Privacy Policy. By using this site, you consent to the collection and use of information as outlined in that policy.

7. Third-Party Links and Embedded Content

Our website may include links to third-party websites, tools, or videos for additional resources. These external sites have their own privacy policies and terms, and the Tankless is not responsible for their content or practices. We encourage you to review any external site’s terms before interacting with them.

8. Warranty and Service Terms

Product warranties and service guarantees are subject to specific terms outlined at the time of purchase or installation. While we ensure high-quality workmanship and reliable products, the Tankless is not responsible for issues arising from user negligence, unauthorized modifications, or third-party repairs.

9. Updates and Modifications

We may update or revise these Terms and Conditions at any time to reflect changes in our services, legal requirements, or operational policies. All updates will be posted on this page with an updated effective date. Continued use of our website signifies your acceptance of any modified terms.

10. Governing Law

These Terms and Conditions are governed by the laws of the Province of Ontario, Canada. Any disputes arising from the use of our website or services will be resolved under Ontario jurisdiction.

11. Contact Us

If you have questions or concerns regarding these Terms and Conditions, please contact us at:
  • support@thetankless.ca
  • http://localhost/thetankless

item.title: 10 Ways to Extend the Lifespan of Your Tankless Water Heater
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Nothing ruins a morning faster than a sudden blast of cold water when you expected a warm, relaxing shower. For most Ontario homeowners, the water heater quietly does its job day after day — until it doesn’t. When that happens, it’s not only inconvenient but can also mean costly repairs or premature replacement.

The good news is that with a few smart habits, your tankless water heater can provide reliable, efficient hot water for 20 years or more. At The Tankless, our technology is specifically designed to handle Ontario’s hard-water conditions and deliver lasting performance.

Here are ten simple but effective ways to keep your tankless system running at its best for years to come.

1. Schedule Annual Professional Maintenance

Even though tankless systems require less maintenance than traditional tanks, an annual inspection helps ensure optimal performance. A licensed technician can check the gas pressure, clean burners, test sensors, and confirm that airflow and venting are clear.

Think of it like a yearly check-up for your home’s hot-water system. Small tune-ups prevent bigger issues later and help your heater maintain peak efficiency all year long.

The Tankless’s trained technicians specialize in tankless systems and can handle all inspections with precision and care.

2. Use Built-In Scale Prevention Technology

Ontario’s hard water is packed with minerals that can damage internal components over time. These minerals form limescale on the heat exchanger, reducing heating efficiency and increasing energy consumption.

That’s where AquaShield™ ScaleGuard, built into The Tankless, makes all the difference. This patented technology prevents scale before it starts, protecting the heat exchanger from buildup and saving you from costly descaling. Most homeowners save $250 to $350 per year in maintenance costs thanks to AquaShield™.

3. Keep Air Intake and Exhaust Vents Clear

Tankless units rely on efficient airflow. If the venting becomes obstructed by dust, lint, or snow, the heater must work harder and may even shut down as a safety measure.

Make it a habit to inspect the outdoor vent openings a few times per year, especially during winter. Keeping them clear ensures efficient combustion, prevents system lockouts, and extends the unit’s lifespan.

4. Maintain Steady Water Flow

A tankless system depends on continuous water flow to activate heating. Blocked aerators or showerheads can restrict flow and cause inconsistent temperatures.

Check your faucets regularly and clean any buildup on showerheads. A strong, steady flow ensures your system performs smoothly and consistently.

5. Protect Against Freezing Temperatures

Even though tankless heaters are compact and durable, they can still be affected by extreme cold. For outdoor installations or garage setups, make sure the pipes are insulated and the vents are shielded from frost.

The Tankless models feature built-in freeze protection, but an insulated environment further ensures reliable operation during Ontario’s harsh winters.

6. Flush Only When Necessary

Traditional water heaters need frequent flushing because sediment collects at the bottom of the tank. Tankless systems heat water as it flows, so buildup is minimal.

If your unit doesn’t include AquaShield™ protection, occasional flushing may still help remove trace minerals. However, with The Tankless, this step is rarely required, as the system continuously prevents scale formation internally.

7. Monitor Your Digital Display

Modern tankless units include digital diagnostic displays that show temperature, flow, and error alerts. Checking these indicators helps you detect any issues early.

The SmartFlow™ Digital Display in The Tankless provides real-time insights such as water temperature, pump activity, and flame presence. A quick glance can confirm your unit is performing as expected.

8. Install a Water Filter or Softener for Added Protection

Even with AquaShield™ protection, a whole-home water filter or softener can further reduce sediment and mineral buildup. It’s a simple way to enhance efficiency and extend the lifespan of your tankless system.

This upgrade is especially helpful in cities like Kitchener, Waterloo, or Vaughan, where mineral levels are among the highest in Ontario.

9. Give Your Tankless System Breathing Room

Tankless units need open space around them to operate efficiently. Avoid storing boxes, laundry, or cleaning supplies near the unit.

Good airflow reduces strain on the system and allows easier access for technicians during maintenance visits. A clear installation area contributes to a safer and longer-lasting heater.

10. Use It Regularly and Choose the Right Model

Tankless systems work best when used consistently. Regular usage keeps the sensors, burners, and internal components active and responsive.

Select the model that matches your home’s size and hot-water needs. The InfinityFlow™ model is ideal for larger families and homes with multiple bathrooms, while PureFlow™ offers reliable performance for smaller households. Choosing the right fit from the start reduces wear and maximizes longevity.

Bonus: Professional Installation Makes All the Difference

Tankless systems work best when used consistently. Regular usage keeps the sensors, burners, and internal components active and responsive.

Select the model that matches your home’s size and hot-water needs. The InfinityFlow™ model is ideal for larger families and homes with multiple bathrooms, while PureFlow™ offers reliable performance for smaller households. Choosing the right fit from the start reduces wear and maximizes longevity.

The Tankless Advantage

While many water heaters need annual flushing and frequent maintenance, The Tankless is built to last twice as long with half the effort.

Here’s what sets it apart:

  • AquaShield ScaleGuard eliminates descaling entirely.
  • SmartFlow Digital Control delivers precise temperatures and real-time system data.
  • Stainless-steel heat exchangers resist corrosion and last decades.
  • Compact wall-mounted design saves valuable space.
  • Hard-Water Warranty covers Ontario homes fully.
Durable, efficient, and virtually maintenance-free, The Tankless redefines what reliability means in hot-water systems.

Final Thoughts

Your tankless water heater is one of the most dependable systems in your home — and with the right care, it will stay that way for decades. A little attention goes a long way in ensuring consistent comfort, lower utility bills, and zero interruptions.

At The Tankless, we design every system for long-term performance, even in Ontario’s toughest hard-water regions. Whether you’re upgrading from a traditional tank or maintaining your current system, these best practices will help you enjoy endless comfort and confidence in your investment.

If you’re ready to experience the future of water heating, book your free consultation today and discover why more Ontarians are switching to The Tankless — built for hard water, built for efficiency, and built to last.

FAQs

1How long does a tankless water heater last in Ontario?A high-quality tankless water heater like The Tankless by LG Home Comfort can last up to 20 years or more with proper maintenance and care. Built-in AquaShield™ protection prevents scale damage, extending lifespan even in hard-water areas.2Do tankless water heaters need to be flushed every year?Not all tankless systems require annual flushing. With AquaShield™ ScaleGuard technology, The Tankless prevents scale buildup automatically, eliminating the need for routine descaling or flushing. 3What maintenance does a tankless water heater require? Tankless systems should be inspected annually to ensure venting, sensors, and burners are in good condition. With The Tankless, maintenance is minimal since scale prevention is automatic and internal components are corrosion-resistant. 4Can hard water damage a tankless water heater? Hard water can shorten the lifespan of most heaters, but The Tankless is engineered for Ontario’s hard-water conditions. AquaShield™ ScaleGuard stops mineral buildup, protecting the heat exchanger and maintaining performance. 5How can I make my tankless water heater more energy-efficient?Use professional installation, maintain proper water flow, keep vents clear, and check system alerts on the SmartFlow™ display. The Tankless already operates up to 30% more efficiently than traditional systems.6Is The Tankless suitable for large families or multi-bathroom homes?Yes. The InfinityFlow™ model delivers continuous hot water across multiple fixtures, while the PureFlow™ model offers efficient performance for smaller homes. Both ensure you never run out of hot water, no matter your household size.

At The Tankless, Your Comfort Comes First

The Tankless is a Canadian, family-run HVAC company dedicated to keeping your home comfortable year-round. We’re available 24/7 to lend a hand whenever you need it. Our licensed, experienced technicians are true professionals—trained to deliver reliable service with a personal touch. When you call us, expect friendly faces, on-time service, and lasting comfort—that’s the Tankless promise. UpgradetoTanklessToday Downloadbrochure

Our Mission

At The Tankless, we believe hot water should be effortless, efficient, and worry-free. We’re here to change how Canadians experience on-demand hot water—no scaling, no downtime, no hassle. Our mission is simple: to deliver endless hot water with zero maintenance, powered by smart and dependable technology built for your home.

Our Story

The Tankless was founded with one clear goal: to eliminate the maintenance headaches and performance issues that come with traditional water heaters. In many Ontario homes, hard water takes a toll on systems over time, leading to scaling, inefficiency, and costly upkeep. We set out to change that. Through innovation and precision engineering, we created a tankless water heater built to withstand real Canadian conditions, delivering consistent performance, zero maintenance, and lasting comfort homeowners can count on. 

Our Mission

At THE TANKLESS, we believe hot water should be effortless, efficient, and worry-free. We exist to redefine how homeowners experience on-demand hot water—no scaling, no downtime, no guesswork. Our goal is simple: deliver endless hot water with zero maintenance, wrapped in smart, dependable technology. mi

ExploreMore

Our Story

THE TANKLESS was born out of a passion to solve one of the most frustrating problems homeowners face: maintenance hassles and performance loss in traditional tank-based water heaters—especially in areas with hard water. As part of the LG Home Comfort family, we combined decades of HVAC and water-heating experience with fresh innovation to build a next-generation solution engineered for real conditions. We saw that switching to tankless systems often introduced new pain points (frequent descaling, component wear, uncertainty about performance in hard water). So we set out to do something better: a tankless heater that doesn’t just “work,” but works reliably, over the long-term, with minimal effort from the user. 360-Degree Vision Motion Tracking Real-Time Interaction Play VideoKnow More

What Makes Us Different

Zero Maintenance Required

From installation onward, The Tankless runs effortlessly—no descaling, chemical treatments, or service visits required. It’s built to work reliably day after day, delivering lasting comfort with zero upkeep. 

Advanced Scale Protection

Hard water is no match for our advanced scale protection system. It prevents mineral buildup before it starts, safeguarding internal components and removing the need for annual cleaning. Enjoy consistent performance, fewer repairs, and complete peace of mind. 

Smart, Efficient, Space-Saving

  • Heats only what you need, when you need it, reducing energy consumption vs. conventional tanks
  • Compact wall-mounted design frees up valuable floor space
  • Optional Wi-Fi or OneTouch™ remote module lets you monitor and control with ease
  • Real-time digital feedback on flow, pump activity, flame status, and standby modes

The Tankless heats only what you need, when you need it—reducing energy use and costs. Its compact, wall-mounted design frees up space, while optional Wi-Fi or OneTouch control gives you easy access and real-time insights. 

Built for Real Conditions

Engineered for tough Canadian water, The Tankless performs where others can’t. It delivers steady hot water in high-mineral areas, ensuring efficiency, reliability, and durability year after year. 

Our Process

3-Step Install Process

  • InstallWe wall-mount the unit, connect venting (2"/3"), gas, water, and condensate lines.
  • SetupWe configure temperature, pump timers, and (optional) Wi-Fi.
  • WalkthroughWe test water flow, ensure everything runs perfectly, explain maintenance and warranty details, and register your product for you.
Fear No Water

Water-repellent barrier

Rain or Shine, Your Protection Is Prime

Lightweight & Foldable0-Kmph
in 4.5 Sec***

Trusted Reviews

What Our Customers Are Saying

Real Ontario Results — Endless Hot Water, Lower Bills, and Zero Descaling Hassles
John
Toronto
“Hard water killed our old tank. With The Tankless, we’ve had zero issues – and I love controlling it from my phone.”
Jennifer
Kitchener
“We switched to The Tankless and instantly cut our bills. Plus, no more fights over hot water in the mornings!”
Michael
Waterloo
“Finally, hot water that doesn’t quit. No scaling, no stress – just comfort every day.”
Ongoing Support
Our team is here to assist you 24/7/365 with any queries.
Trustworthy Services
We ensure a top-notch customer experience.
Clear & Honest Pricing
Know exactly what you’re paying for — transparent pricing with zero hidden fees
Proudly Canadian

Why Go Tankless?

Compact, efficient, and built to last.

Built for real homes, tankless systems deliver consistent, efficient hot water that lasts—without the maintenance hassles of old tanks.

  • Lower Energy Bills Heats water only when needed, reducing energy consumption and lowering monthly bills.
  • Endless Hot WaterHot water on demand – no more waiting or running out. Enjoy back-to-back showers, laundry, and dishes without interruption.
  • Space SavingWall-mounted design frees up floor space.
  • Longer LifespanBuilt tough and reliable—tankless units last up to twice as long as traditional tanks.

item.title: How Do Tankless Water Heaters Work?
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
If you’ve ever wondered how a water heater can deliver endless hot water without a storage tank, you’re not alone. Tankless technology has completely redefined how Ontario homeowners heat water—providing constant comfort, better efficiency, and a smaller footprint.

At the Tankless, our systems are built for Canadian homes that deal with hard water and fluctuating seasonal demands. We combine powerful heating performance with advanced protection like AquaShield™ ScaleGuard, ensuring reliability without the maintenance headaches.

Let’s take a closer look at how tankless water heaters actually work, what makes them so efficient, and why they’ve become the smarter choice for modern homes.

What Is a Tankless Water Heater?

A tankless water heater—also called an on-demand water heater—doesn’t store hot water in a tank. Instead, it heats water only when you turn on a tap or appliance. Cold water enters the system, flows across a powerful heating element or gas burner, and comes out hot just seconds later.

Because there’s no tank to refill or keep warm, tankless units save energy, eliminate standby heat loss, and deliver an uninterrupted stream of hot water as long as you need it. The result is comfort on demand and efficiency that lasts year after year.

How Tankless Water Heaters Work: Step-by-Step

While models vary slightly, the core operation of every tankless water heater follows the same process. Here’s how the system transforms cold groundwater into steady, hot water for your home.
1. Cold Water Enters the System
When you open a hot-water tap or start your shower, cold water travels through your plumbing and into the tankless unit. Flow sensors inside the system instantly detect the movement of water and trigger the heating process.
2. Activation of the Heating Element or Gas Burner
Once the flow is detected, the heating component turns on.

  • In gas models, a burner ignites, sending heat into a metal heat exchanger.
  • In electric models, powerful elements warm the water directly as it passes through.
The entire process begins within seconds of turning on the tap.
3. Water Circulates Through the Heat Exchanger
As the water moves through the unit, it flows around (or over) the heat exchanger’s internal coils. The exchanger rapidly transfers energy to the water, raising its temperature to the desired level.

The Tankless systems use high-efficiency stainless-steel exchangers that resist corrosion, maintain consistent heating, and perform exceptionally well in Ontario’s hard-water regions.
4. Precision Temperature Control
Modern tankless systems use digital sensors to continuously monitor and adjust water temperature. The SmartFlow™ Digital Display in The Tankless models ensures precise, stable heating with no sudden hot-cold fluctuations.

This level of control keeps every shower comfortable—even when multiple fixtures are in use.
5. Instant Delivery to Fixtures
Once the water reaches the target temperature, it flows directly to your faucet, shower, or appliance. The process is seamless and continuous, providing endless hot water for as long as you need it.
6. Automatic Shut-Off
When you close the tap, the flow sensors detect that movement has stopped. The heating element powers down automatically, conserving energy until the next time you call for hot water.

This on-demand cycle repeats every time you need hot water—whether for showers, laundry, or washing dishes.

Gas vs. Electric Tankless Systems

Both types of tankless water heaters operate on the same principle but use different energy sources.
Gas Tankless Water Heaters
Gas units heat water using natural gas or propane. When water flow is detected, the gas burner ignites and transfers heat to the exchanger. These models typically have a higher heating capacity, making them ideal for larger households with simultaneous demand.

They require professional installation and venting but are often more economical to operate when gas rates are low.
Electric Tankless Water Heaters
Electric models use heating elements instead of burners. They’re compact, easier to install, and produce no combustion gases, making them an environmentally friendly option. They’re perfect for smaller households or homes that don’t have gas lines.

For Ontario homeowners, the choice often depends on energy rates, household size, and installation layout.

The Science Behind Sizing and Flow Rates

To choose the right tankless unit, you must match its heating capacity to your home’s flow rate and temperature rise.

  • Flow Rate (GPM): How much hot water your home uses at once, measured in gallons per minute.
    For example, a shower might use 1.5 GPM while a faucet uses 1.0 GPM. If both run together, your heater must supply at least 2.5 GPM.
  • Temperature Rise: The difference between incoming cold water and your desired output temperature.
    Ontario groundwater can be as cold as 45°F (7°C) in winter. To reach a comfortable shower temperature of 110°F (43°C), your tankless heater needs to deliver a temperature rise of about 65°F.
InfinityFlow™ models from The Tankless are designed to handle higher flow rates and greater temperature rise effortlessly—perfect for large families and cold Canadian winters.

Why Tankless Water Heaters Are More Efficient

Traditional storage tanks constantly reheat the same water to maintain temperature, wasting energy through standby heat loss. Tankless systems eliminate that waste by heating only what you use, exactly when you use it.

This on-demand process can reduce water-heating energy consumption by up to 30 percent annually. Additionally, since there’s no tank that corrodes or leaks, you avoid costly repairs and enjoy a lifespan that’s often twice as long—typically 20 years or more.

The Tankless Advantage

What makes The Tankless stand apart isn’t just efficiency—it’s longevity and protection.

  • AquaShield™ ScaleGuard stops mineral buildup before it starts, ensuring Ontario’s hard water never harms your system.
  • SmartFlow Digital Display offers precise control, easy monitoring, and built-in diagnostics.
  • InfinityFlow (Premium) and PureFlow (Standard) models provide flexible solutions for every household size.
  • Compact, wall-mounted design frees up space compared with bulky storage tanks.
  • ENERGY STAR®-rated performance means lower bills and a smaller carbon footprint.
While standard tankless systems require annual descaling, The Tankless stays clean and efficient automatically, saving hundreds of dollars in maintenance every year.

Advantages of Going Tankless

  1. Endless Hot Water: Continuous heating means you never run out, even during peak use.
  2. Energy Efficiency: Heat only what you need, reducing energy waste and utility costs.
  3. Longer Lifespan: Durable components and scale prevention ensure decades of performance.
  4. Space Savings: Wall-mounted design clears valuable floor space in your utility area.
  5. Cleaner Operation: No tank means no rust, leaks, or sediment buildup.
  6. Eco-Friendly: Reduced fuel consumption and replaceable parts make tankless units more sustainable.

Are There Any Drawbacks?

While the benefits far outweigh them, tankless systems do have considerations:

  • Higher initial cost compared to tank models.
  • May need plumbing or venting upgrades during installation.
  • Require professional installation for best performance.
However, with The Tankless, these are minor factors. Our licensed technicians handle all installation details, and AquaShield™ ensures maintenance remains minimal.

Final Thoughts

A tankless water heater is more than an appliance—it’s a long-term comfort investment. By heating water only when you need it, it delivers immediate efficiency, lower costs, and a virtually endless supply of hot water.

For Ontario homes with hard water, The Tankless is the clear choice. Designed with cutting-edge technology and backed by trusted service, it’s the most advanced on-demand system available today.

If you’re ready to upgrade to cleaner, smarter, and more efficient water heating, schedule your free consultation today and discover the difference that The Tankless makes.

FAQs

1What is the main difference between tankless and traditional water heaters?Traditional heaters store and reheat a limited volume of water in a tank. Tankless systems heat water instantly as it flows, delivering endless hot water and reducing energy waste.2How do gas and electric tankless water heaters differ?Gas units use burners and heat exchangers to warm water, while electric models rely on heating elements. Gas versions handle higher flow rates; electric ones are compact and eco-friendly.3How long do tankless water heaters last?Most tankless systems last around 20 years or more—roughly twice as long as tank water heaters. With AquaShield™ protection, The Tankless maintains efficiency throughout its lifespan.4Can a tankless water heater handle multiple showers at once? Yes, especially with premium models like InfinityFlow™, which offer higher GPM capacity and integrated recirculation for consistent temperature across multiple fixtures.5Do tankless water heaters need regular maintenance?Standard tankless systems need annual descaling, but The Tankless prevents scale buildup automatically using AquaShield™, reducing maintenance to simple yearly inspections.6Are tankless water heaters energy-efficient?Absolutely. By heating water only on demand, tankless units cut standby losses and can lower water-heating energy use by up to 30 percent.

item.title: Hot Water Not Hot Enough? Here’s Why—and How a Tankless System Solves It for Good in Ontario
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
If you’ve ever stepped into a shower only to find the water barely warm, you’re not alone. Across Ontario, countless homeowners experience the same frustration every winter. One minute your shower is soothing, the next you’re shivering under a stream of lukewarm water.

Most people assume their water heater just needs a quick fix or a bigger tank. In reality, the problem is far more common and much deeper. Traditional water heaters are limited by design, especially when it comes to Ontario’s hard-water conditions. Minerals like calcium and magnesium quietly build up inside tanks, choking efficiency and causing uneven heating over time.

That’s why The Tankless was created. It’s a modern solution designed for Canadian homes that delivers continuous hot water, lower utility costs, and zero descaling. If your current water heater can’t keep up, it might be time to understand why – and how a tankless system solves it for good.

1. The Real Cause Behind Lukewarm Water: Limited Capacity

Traditional water heaters store a fixed amount of preheated water. Once that hot water runs out, you’re left waiting while the tank refills and reheats. For large households, that wait can feel endless. If two people shower back-to-back or you start a load of laundry while someone is using the bathroom, the system simply can’t keep up.

The Tankless Solution: Tankless systems don’t rely on storage at all. Instead, they heat water instantly as it flows through the unit. You get continuous, on-demand hot water whenever and wherever you need it. With models like InfinityFlow™ and PureFlow™, your home never runs out of heat, even when multiple taps are open. Families can finally stop scheduling showers around the water heater.

2. The Ontario Problem: Hard Water and Sediment Buildup

Ontario water is naturally hard, filled with minerals that cause limescale and sediment buildup. Over time, this layer acts as insulation, preventing heat from transferring efficiently. The result is longer heating cycles, poor performance, and higher gas or electricity bills.

Homeowners often spend hundreds of dollars each year on maintenance or professional descaling just to keep their tank running. But even with regular care, the buildup always returns.

The Tankless Solution: Every Tankless system includes AquaShield™ ScaleGuard, a built-in layer of protection that prevents mineral buildup before it starts. It protects the heat exchanger, keeps water flowing freely, and saves you from expensive annual descaling services. Ontario homeowners typically save between $250 and $350 per year just by eliminating that one maintenance task.

3. Hidden Energy Waste and Rising Utility Bills

Conventional water heaters are constantly running, even when no one is using hot water. That’s because the water stored inside slowly loses heat throughout the day, forcing the system to reheat it again and again. This cycle, known as standby heat loss, wastes a significant amount of energy.

In most homes, heating water accounts for nearly one-fifth of the total energy bill. Over time, that inefficiency becomes a costly burden.

The Tankless Solution: The Tankless only activates when you turn on the tap. It uses precise, on-demand heating that eliminates standby losses and lowers energy use by up to 30 percent per year. With an efficiency rating as high as 0.95 UEF and full ENERGY STAR® certification, it’s one of the most economical and environmentally friendly ways to heat water in Ontario.

4. Frequent Repairs and Short Equipment Lifespan

A standard water heater usually lasts about eight to ten years. Hard water, rust, and sediment make sure of that. Once the interior lining weakens or the tank begins to corrode, repairs become frequent and costly. Eventually, most homeowners face leaks, rust stains, or even full system replacements.

The Tankless Solution: Because it has no storage tank, The Tankless avoids the main causes of early failure. Its heat exchangers are built from stainless steel or hybrid copper materials that resist corrosion and extend lifespan. With proper installation and minimal upkeep, these systems can last twenty years or longer. That means fewer breakdowns, fewer repair calls, and far greater long-term value.

5. The Battle Between Pressure and Temperature

If your shower suddenly turns cold when someone else runs a tap, it’s not just annoying – it’s a sign your system can’t handle simultaneous demand. Tank heaters deliver a limited flow, so as more fixtures draw water, pressure and temperature drop sharply.

The Tankless Solution: The Tankless uses SmartFlow™ digital control to maintain steady temperature and water pressure throughout your home. Even if multiple taps or showers are in use, you’ll enjoy consistent comfort without those sudden bursts of cold. The premium InfinityFlow™ model also includes a RapidHot™ Pump, which circulates preheated water through your plumbing for instant heat at every faucet.

6. Lost Space and Outdated Design

Traditional tanks are bulky, heavy, and take up valuable floor space in basements, closets, or laundry areas. For smaller homes, condos, and townhouses, this can be a real inconvenience.

The Tankless Solution: A Tankless unit mounts neatly on the wall, freeing up space for storage or other utilities. Despite its compact footprint, it delivers stronger performance than a conventional heater. Many homeowners love that their new system looks clean, modern, and blends seamlessly into their utility room or garage.

7. Built Specifically for Ontario Conditions

Not every tankless water heater performs well in Canada’s climate. Imported units often struggle with Ontario’s combination of hard water and cold inlet temperatures. This leads to premature wear and reduced heating capacity during winter months.

The Tankless is built differently. Each model is engineered for Canada’s unique conditions, with materials and internal components designed to handle hard water and freezing groundwater. The warranty even covers hard-water usage, something most manufacturers exclude. That level of protection means true peace of mind for Ontario homeowners who want reliable hot water all year long.

8. Lower Bills and a Cleaner Footprint

Tankless water heaters do more than improve comfort; they make your home more sustainable. Because they only heat water when it’s needed, they consume far less energy and reduce greenhouse gas emissions.

For households in Ontario, where energy prices continue to rise, those savings are substantial. Lower bills, fewer repairs, and longer lifespan all contribute to a faster return on investment. Over time, The Tankless not only pays for itself but also helps reduce your home’s environmental impact.

9. Real Home Comfort in Real Ontario Homes

Many homeowners notice an immediate difference after switching to The Tankless. The first thing they mention is the consistency – no more temperature swings or waiting for the water to heat up. The second is peace of mind. There’s no maintenance calendar, no descaling appointments, and no more worrying about whether the tank is rusting from the inside out.

A family in Kitchener shared how their gas bill dropped noticeably after installation. Another homeowner in Toronto mentioned that even with three showers running and the dishwasher on, the temperature never fluctuated. In Waterloo, one couple described it simply: “Finally, hot water that doesn’t quit.”

That kind of reliability is what The Tankless was built for – consistent comfort that lasts.

10. Quick Installation and Lasting Performance

Installation is straightforward and handled entirely by licensed technicians. Each project begins with an assessment to size the unit properly, review venting requirements, and plan recirculation options. The team then installs the wall-mounted unit, connects gas and water lines, and runs full performance tests.

Most installations take less than a day, and every homeowner receives a detailed walkthrough explaining settings, temperature controls, warranty registration, and optional Wi-Fi features. For those who prefer convenience, the OneTouch™ Hot Water Remote Kit provides easy access and monitoring from anywhere in your home.

11. A Smarter Long-Term Investment

When comparing prices, a tankless system may seem like a higher upfront cost. But once you factor in its efficiency, lifespan, and minimal maintenance, the total ownership cost is significantly lower than a traditional tank. You also avoid unexpected service calls and annual descaling fees.

In other words, you’re not just upgrading your equipment; you’re upgrading your comfort, savings, and peace of mind. With The Tankless, you invest once and benefit for decades.

12. The Future of Hot Water in Ontario Homes

Water heating has evolved. Homeowners no longer need to choose between convenience and efficiency. With The Tankless, you can have both.

Its advanced AquaShield™ protection ensures your system performs like new year after year. Its energy-saving design reduces waste and lowers your bills. And its compact, wall-mounted build frees up space while providing more power than a tank ever could.

For Ontario homes battling hard water, cold winters, and high energy costs, this isn’t just a better option – it’s the next generation of home comfort.

If you’re tired of inconsistent temperatures and high maintenance bills, it’s time to make the switch. Choose The Tankless and enjoy endless hot water, lower costs, and total peace of mind, all backed by trusted expertise.

Final Thoughts

If your water isn’t getting hot enough—or you’re tired of running out altogether—it’s time to upgrade. The Tankless offers endless hot water, energy savings, and zero maintenance worries, built specifically for Ontario homes with hard water.

Say goodbye to cold showers and hello to the smarter, cleaner, and more efficient way to heat water.

Frequently Asked Questions

1Will a tankless water heater solve low-temperature issues in my home? Yes! A tankless system heats water instantly, so you’ll never experience lukewarm or fluctuating temperatures again.2How does The Tankless handle Ontario’s hard water?It includes Integrated Scale Prevention Technology, which stops mineral buildup automatically—no descaling required. 3Is it true that tankless systems cost less to operate?Absolutely. Since they only heat water on demand, they’re far more energy-efficient, saving you up to 30% annually.4Can a tankless water heater supply multiple showers at once?Yes. The Tankless provides continuous, on-demand heating that maintains water temperature across multiple fixtures. 5How long does a tankless water heater last compared to a tank model? A traditional tank lasts about 8–10 years, while a tankless water heater can last 20+ years with minimal care.

item.title: About Us
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Where Hot Water
Meets, Quiet Precision

About the Tankless
the Tankless brings smart, space-saving, and cost-efficient hot water solutions to Canadian households. Built with engineering precision and designed for year-round Canadian weather, our advanced tankless technology delivers endless hot water while reducing energy use and freeing up valuable space. We focus on comfort, efficiency, and practicality—giving homeowners a modern, affordable way to upgrade their home’s performance. UpgradetoTanklessToday Downloadbrochure

OUR STORY: Built for Real-Life Demands

the Tankless started with a straightforward idea: home should make life easier. Many people were dealing with bulky tanks, wasted space, and higher energy costs than necessary. We knew there was a better option. A system that heats water only when you need it, frees up room, and helps reduce everyday waste. the Tankless was created to offer that simple improvement — reliable hot water, less hassle, and a home that works more smoothly for you. Our Mission

Engineered to deliver dependable hot water with less noise, less waste, and fewer moving parts.

We design every system—from combustion to controls—to give Canadians year-round comfort without the maintenance, temperature swings, or inefficiencies of old tank systems. Our mission is simple: to provide stable, efficient, future-ready hot water built for the demands of modern Canadian homes.

Endless Hot Water

Zero Maintenance

Smart Technology

What Makes Us Different

Low-Intervention Comfort Thoughtful internal protections are designed to help reduce scale buildup and keep performance consistent, limiting the interruptions that come with many traditional systems—especially important during cold Canadian winters when you need reliable hot water most. Clarity for Canadian Pros Logical layout and accessible components make installation and servicing straightforward for trained professionals across Ontario and beyond, saving time on site and meeting local building standards. Optimized for Tight Spaces The compact format is ideal for mechanical closets, multi-unit projects, and renovations where every square foot matters—whether you're in a Toronto condo or a suburban home. Comfort You Can Count On From first install to everyday operation, Tankless is designed to be a stable, trusted source of hot water in the background of daily life—through every Canadian season.

Our Simple 3-Step Installation

From start to finish, it's seamless, efficient, and built around your comfort.

Install

Licensed professionals mount the unit, confirm venting and gas sizing to meet Canadian building codes, and connect water lines with a focus on safety and long-term performance.

Step 01

Setup

System settings are calibrated to your fixtures and local water conditions so every tap and shower behaves predictably throughout the year.

Step 02

Walkthrough

You're guided through basic controls, seasonal maintenance checks, and warranty registration, so you understand exactly what's in your home.

Step 03

Hear From Our Happy Homeowners

Jennifer
Kitchener
“We switched to The Tankless and instantly cut our bills. Plus, no more fights over hot water in the mornings!”
John
Toronto
“Hard water killed our old tank. With The Tankless, we’ve had zero issues – and I love controlling it from my phone.”
Michael
Waterloo
“Finally, hot water that doesn’t quit. No scaling, no stress – just comfort every day.”

About Us

Where Hot Water
Meets, Quiet Precision

the Tankless brings smart, space-saving, and cost-efficient hot water solutions to Canadian households. Built with engineering precision and designed for year-round Canadian weather, our advanced tankless technology delivers endless hot water while reducing energy use and freeing up valuable space. We focus on comfort, efficiency, and practicality—giving homeowners a modern, affordable way to upgrade their home’s performance.

Endless Hot Water  Zero Maintenance  Smart Technology  Built for Canada Endless Hot Water Endless Hot Water  Zero Maintenance  Smart Technology  Built for Canada Endless Hot Water  Our Story Built for
Real-Life
Demands The Tankless started with a straightforward idea: home should make life easier. Many people were dealing with bulky tanks, wasted space, and higher energy costs than necessary. We knew there was a better option. A system that heats water only when you need it, and helps reduce everyday waste.The Tankless was created to offer that simple improvement — reliable hot water, less hassle, and a home that works more smoothly for you. Our Mission "Engineered to deliver dependable hot water with less noise, less waste, and fewer moving parts." We design every system — from combustion to controls — to give Canadians
year-round comfort without the maintenance, temperature swings, or inefficiencies of old tank systems.

Endless Hot Water

Hot water on demand, every time — no running out, no waiting.

Zero Maintenance

Designed to operate quietly in the background — season after season.

Smart Technology

Monitor and control from your phone — precise, connected, modern.

What Makes Us Different

Built from the ground up for Canadian homes, Canadian pros, and Canadian winters.

4

Core Advantages

Zero

Scale Buildup

100%

On-Demand Heating

Our Mission 01

Low-Intervention Comfort

Thoughtful internal protections reduce scale buildup and keep performance consistent — especially critical during cold Canadian winters when you need reliable hot water most. 02

Clarity for Canadian Pros

Logical layout and accessible components make installation and servicing straightforward for trained professionals across Ontario and beyond — saving time and meeting local building standards. 03

Optimized for Tight Spaces

Compact format ideal for mechanical closets, multi-unit projects, and renovations — whether you're in a Toronto condo or a suburban home. 04

Comfort You Can Count On

From first install to everyday operation, Tankless is designed to be a stable, trusted source of hot water — through every Canadian season. Our Simple 3-Step Installation From start to finish, it's seamless, efficient, and built around your comfort.
  • Step 01

INSTALL

We wall-mount the system and connect all venting, gas, and water lines.

  • Step 02

SETUP

We fine-tune temperature, timers, and Wi-Fi options.

  • Step 03

WALKTHROUGH

We test everything, show you how it works, and even register your warranty for you.
